parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If the ID is available, specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
